title: Long term names wrap in the vendor dropdown and card
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The shop's own term {Term-A} has a 31-character name, is deactivated and is held by vendor {Vendor-A}; its own term {Term-B} also has a 31-character name and is active.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S6-07 Long Inactv AA, {Term-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S6-07 Long Active BB and {Vendor-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S6-07 Vendor.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open {Vendor-A}'s vendor page.
  2. Open Edit Vendor.
  3. Open the Credit Terms dropdown.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the card shows the whole of "{Term-A} (Inactive)", wrapping if needed.
  • Step 2: the selected value shows the whole name and "(Inactive)".
  • Step 3: {Term-B} and "{Term-A} (Inactive)" show in full; long names wrap, nothing is cut off.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11675 (Story 6, Vendors)

  • S6-R6: “Term names are never cut off in the vendor Credit Terms dropdown or on the vendor card, including with "(Inactive)"; long names wrap.”
